items.desc: Fast, free voice assistant for your Mac. No API key: runs on your Claude Pro or Max plan. Remembers you and learns your shortcuts. Hold ⌃⌥Space and talk.

CodeAgent is an open-source coding agent that lives in your terminal. It understands your repository, plans multi-step changes, writes and edits files, runs commands and tests, and iterates until the task is done — all with a transparent, extensible tool loop.
Open desktop AI agent for Windows, macOS and Linux, written from scratch: its own agent engine, its own browser tooling and its own drawing engine that shows what it explains.
An iPad IDE with local LLM inference on an AMD GPU over Thunderbolt: the upstream Linux amdgpu driver embedded as DriverKit, LemonSeed Engine, and live GPU telemetry.
